title: qq bot bind/poll response: scan progress, and the credentials exactly once

status.description: pending means the platform has no result yet, so there is nothing to save; scanned means the binding completed and this same response carries appId and appSecret (there is no separate 'scanned but unconfirmed' state); expired means the task can no longer complete, because the QR code expired or the credentials were already taken by an earlier poll.

appId.description: Bot AppID, present only once the binding completed.

appSecret.description: Bot AppSecret, returned exactly once together with appId so the component can save it; never logged or echoed again.
